facebook.caption:
POV: you wandered into Grand World at night and suddenly forgot every overpriced resort restaurant you booked.

Chợ đêm Grand World has fresh seafood, cold drinks, and that chaotic night market energy that actually makes dinner feel like an event.

$15-30 a head. 4.3 stars from 111 reviews. Worth every dong.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Grilled shells hitting the table, lanterns everywhere, strangers laughing two seats over. This is what dinner at Chợ đêm Grand World looks like on a Tuesday night.
